articleTitle: Experiment and CFD Analysis of Reactive Muffler
publicationTitle: 2023 9th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: In order to evaluate performance of reactive muffler and its effect on power loss of engine, flow field of muffler was discussed by CFD comparing with experimental test, and the structure of reactive muffler was optimized. Based on results of simulation and optimization, the reactive muffler used in vibratory rollers with weight of 13t was fabricated and its field test was carried on. The simulate results showed that velocity field coincided with the pressure field basically, which indicates that the optimized muffler -2# has excellent aerodynamic characteristics and rational design of damping units. The results of field tests showed that 2# muffler had better acoustic insertion loss with little pressure loss. Acoustic insertion loss was 17 to 18.4 dB(A) at engine speed of 2450rpm, which meets the designing goal.

articleTitle: Adaptive Contribution with Genetic Algorithm in RSSI and AoA Indoor Localization Technology
publicationTitle: 2023 9th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: This article mainly focuses on the RSSI and AoA localization method in the wireless sensor network. In many simulation experiments, while applying hybrid RSSI and AoA localization method, it is found that the accuracy of two methods is different. The key to improve the positioning accuracy is to ensure the weight of such two methods in order that the localization algorithm can rely more on the more accurate method. Based on the error propagation theory, an adaptive contribution is designed as the weight to adjust the contribution of two methods. To solve the MLE model of RSSI and AoA, Genetic algorithm is applied to calculate the coordinate of the unknown target. The simulations show that the performance of this proposed algorithm (ACGA) is better than other algorithms.

articleTitle: Research on Mobile Application-Based Remote Visitation System
publicationTitle: 2023 9th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: The remote video visiting system has been running on some of the prison, rehab and detention center. It’s realize the inconvenience of remote visiting, the sick and elderly relatives to visit and remote assistance personnel to visit. An effective way was provided for enhance the prisoners' education reform in personnel quality and ease the psychological pressure.But the same time, the existing remote video visiting system which in the private network can not exchange with other network, the universal remote video system controllability is not security enough, remote video visiting can not achieve the mobile set applications and so on. Using the mature technology, such as network communication the audio and the video, can achieve full network interoperability, can achieve remote controlled release with automated security extension, can announce the publicly information by mobile. Remote video visiting system can solve in the mobile. It’s the innovation service windows of convenient for people.

articleTitle: Prediction of SO2 Emission Concentration in Thermal Power Plants Based on SSA-LSTM Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2023 9th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: In order to improve the prediction accuracy of SO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> emission concentration, a SO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> concentration prediction model based on SSA optimized LSTM neural network is proposed for SO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> pollutant emission from coal-fired units in power plants. By using the combination of SSA and LSTM neural network, the optimal position of threshold update is quickly found in the local search to provide better parameters for the training of LSTM. The SSA-LSTM concentration prediction model is constructed using Python and simulated to compare with the LSTM prediction model, and the test results show that the SSA-LSTM neural network model is utilized to predict the concentration of SO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> emission with good stability, and fast convergence, and the prediction accuracy is higher compared with the LSTM neural network model.

articleTitle: User-Level Large Scale Load Forecasting Based on GPU
publicationTitle: 2023 9th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: Load forecasting is an essential part in power system management and planning. In recent years, more and more researchers started to focus on the behavior of terminal customers, trying to improve the accuracy of load forecasting. This paper proposes to use the neuron network model to predict each user’s load first, and then aggregate all the forecasting results to get higher-level prediction. In order to speed up the process, we also design a model based on CUDA. We conducted several experiments on real-world data (160 thousand consumers’ load profiles) and the results confirm the effectiveness and efficiency of our method.

articleTitle: Development of distributed vibration monitoring system with high synchronous acquisition accuracy
publicationTitle: 2023 9th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: Vibration monitoring technology is an important means to recognize the state of machines and equipments, and has been widely used in industrial applications, such as predictive maintenance. With the rapid development of industry 4.0, the scale of industrial system increases, which requires large-scale vibration monitoring system for data acquisition. However, how to implement large-scale vibration monitoring remains a challenging problem. In this paper, a distributed vibration monitoring system is designed to solve the scalability problem of large-scale vibration monitoring. In order to realize high-speed signal acquisition, we design a hybrid architecture of FPGA+MCU, in which FPGA is used for concurrent acquisition and MCU is used for distributed control and communication. To provide real-time transmission of collected data, industrial Ethernet EtherCAT is used for transmission. In order to ensure the synchronization of different distributed vibration monitoring node, a high accuracy synchronization scheme is proposed, in which the software and hardware are jointly optimized. The experimental results show that the designed system can achieve high synchronization accuracy, and the average synchronization error is less than 20ns.

articleTitle: Development of a Computer Controlled Horizontal Type Reference Torque Machine
publicationTitle: 2023 9th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: This paper introduces a horizontal type reference torque machine, which is composed of a movable workbench, a control system, a torque loading unit, intelligent standard sensors and a double rolling bearing support mechanism. Automatic or manual loading can be realized through the control system and loading unit. The DS2401 chips are used in standard sensors to avoid human error or wrong channel selection by finding the sensor coefficient and range corresponding to the identification code . The double rolling bearing is used as the support structure of the standard sensor and the measured sensor, which greatly reduces the impact of contact friction on the torque value, improves the measurement accuracy of the reference torque machine.

articleTitle: Research on Improved Security Enhancement Technology Algorithm of Beidou Navigation System
publicationTitle: 2023 9th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: This paper mainly introduces the composition, principle and characteristics of the second generation of Beidou navigation satellite system, summarizes the security technology of Beidou navigation signal, puts forward the improved security enhancement technology-space-time-frequency combined adaptive anti-jamming algorithm, analyzes the advantages of the improved anti-jamming algorithm in principle, and forecasts the development trend of the security technology of Beidou navigation satellite system.

articleTitle: Construction of Intelligent Energy Safety Operation and Maintenance System based on AI Algorithm and Artificial Hard Rules
publicationTitle: 2023 9th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: Energy safety operation and maintenance system is a fast and accurate fault diagnosis process. With the trend of digital development in today's world and the gradual improvement of enterprise's energy safety structure, it is urgent to design a new energy safety operation and maintenance system to ensure the safety of enterprise energy equipment. In this paper, AI and artificial hard rules are combined to design a energy safety operation and maintenance system to replace the old energy safety operation and maintenance system. The historical data of energy equipment is used to build a cloud database, and the data is acquired by sensors in real time for updating and iteration. The scene diagnosis model is built according to the original data and applied to energy safety operation and maintenance system. When the sensor obtains data in real time and input it into the model calculation, the data can be optimized, the risk can be predicted, and the energy scenario diagnosis can be completed quickly and accurately.

Author Keywords: energy safety operation and maintenance system

articleTitle: Predicting Academic Success among College Students Using Machine Learning Techniques Applied to Online Learning Data
publicationTitle: 2023 9th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: Predicting academic success is crucial in educational research, particularly in the context of increasing online learning. This study utilizes machine learning techniques on online learning data to develop predictive models for determining academic success among college students. Various online learning data, including video watching time, chapter visits, and discussion frequency, are collected from a sample of college students. Through the use of random forests and Spearman correlation coefficients, key factors associated with academic success are identified. Logistic regression, random forest, decision tree, and neural network models are trained with these factors for further analysis and prediction, rigorously evaluated using accuracy, precision, recall, and F1 score parameters. Grid search is employed for model optimization when subpar performance is observed. The findings demonstrate the effectiveness of machine learning in predicting academic success, offering valuable insights to enhance student outcomes and implement data-driven interventions in online learning platforms. This research contributes to educational data mining and informs the development of proactive strategies for online education, promoting positive learning outcomes in a rapidly evolving landscape.

articleTitle: DF-AT: A Neural Influence Diffusion for Social Recommendation Based on Attention Mechanism
publicationTitle: 2023 9th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: Conventional recommender systems that based on Collaborative Filtering face difficulties like sparse data and the cold start issue that limit their performance and effectiveness to some extent. To address these issues, social recommendation has emerged as a research hotspot. Wu et al. proposed a neural influence diffusion network (DiffNet) model for social recommendation, which has achieved impressive results by simulating the latent embedding of users that changes with the diffusion process of social influence. By incorporating the attention mechanism into the model, this paper proposes a novel model DF-AT assigns corresponding weights to users based on their social influence and the importance of their interests, which adjusts their influence on users' interests during the information dissemination process, leads to more accurate preference predictions. Finally, experiments are carried out on two data sets, and the result shows the validity of the enhanced method.

articleTitle: An Induction Spray-Type Disinfection Device
publicationTitle: 2023 9th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: Currently, the main disinfection method used in public places involves using bottle-style disinfectants, which require manual pressing that increases contact and infection risk between individuals. Additionally, the quantity of disinfectant dispensed cannot be controlled. Moreover, existing intelligent disinfection devices in the market are expensive and have limited usability. This study proposes an induction spray-type disinfection device that utilizes infrared detection to sense human presence. It employs a miniature water pump to draw the disinfectant and spray it out through a high-pressure nozzle, achieving contactless and automated disinfection, thereby significantly improving disinfection efficiency. The proposed device is compact, lightweight, portable, and applicable in various scenarios. It can operate independently without external force and is easy to use. The contactless disinfection method avoids cross-contamination, ensuring safety and reliability. The device has a long lifespan and low cost, thus showing promising prospects in the disinfection market.

articleTitle: Enhancing Biomedical Research Data Management Challenges and Strategies
publicationTitle: 2023 9th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: In the era of digital research, scientific progress relies on the sharing and reuse of research data. Technological advancements in the biomedical field, such as gene sequencing and proteomics, have accelerated data generation, posing challenges to data management and sharing. This study investigates data management practices of the top 20 biomedical journals by impact factor, exploring the significance and strategies of research data management in the biomedical domain. The paper highlights challenges in biomedical data management, including incomplete data, inconsistent standards, and sharing limitations, while proposing solutions to enhance data quality, standardization, and citation acknowledgment. Through these improvements, credibility and reproducibility of research data can be achieved, fostering enhanced research quality and efficiency in the biomedical field.

articleTitle: Construction of Teaching Plan Model for ASSURE Virtual Simulation Training
publicationTitle: 2023 9th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: With the advent of the era of information technology 2.0, the rapid development of information technology has realized the track change and overtaking. The organic combination of digital technologies such as virtual reality technology, artificial intelligence, virtual simulation technology, and big data with education has created various possibilities for the development of education and teaching. The course of ideological and political education, as a form of implicit ideological and political education, is a supplement to the course of ideological and political education. Integrating ideological and political education into information technology teaching can not only impart knowledge and cultivate abilities, but also shape students with the correct "three views", improve students' information literacy, and make students become builders and successors with both morals and talents. Using the course of "Management Practice of Lobby and Guest Room" as an example, the article analyzes the key points of teaching reform, integrates the ideological and political elements of the course, and studies the psychological activities and the behavioral rules of tourism consumers. Restructure the teaching of the course of "Management Practice of Lobby and Guest Room" and explore the ideological and political construction path of the "Management Practice of Lobby and Guest Room" course for tourism majors under the reform of information technology in colleges and universities.

articleTitle: Highway Obstacle Detection Method Based on PP-YOLOv2
publicationTitle: 2023 9th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: In order to solve the problem that obstacles on the highway cannot be identified in time for warning and lead to traffic accidents, this paper uses PP-YOLOv2 target detection algorithm to effectively identify and classify obstacles on the highway. The highway obstacle training set is utilized for model training, and the testing of the training model is completed through the test set. The test results show that compared with the YOLOv5 algorithm, the PP-YOLOv2 algorithm improves the Rvalue and mAP value of highway obstacle target detection by 1.5% and 1.2%, respectively, which verifies the effectiveness of the model. The study can be used for the detection of highway obstacles, and the detection results can be used to provide early warning to traveling vehicles, and provide information support for the traffic control department to dispatch staff to clear obstacles in time, which has certain practical application value.

articleTitle: Research on Multi-path Scheduling Algorithm for Adaptive Sensor Network Resources
publicationTitle: 2023 9th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: The current conventional adaptive sensor network resource multi-path optimization scheduling algorithm is mainly constructed by calculating the scheduling parameters and the multi-objective scheduling function, which leads to poor balanced scheduling due to the lack of weight assignment to network nodes. In this regard, the adaptive sensor network resource multi-path scheduling algorithm is proposed. By combining the ant colony algorithm, the distribution of network resources inside the sensor network is analyzed. By setting the pheromone node factor, the effective nodes of network resources are extracted. And for the network resource nodes with different degrees of dispersion, the weight allocation strategy is constructed and the multi-path scheduling feature parameters are extracted to construct a scheduling model. In the experiments, the scheduling performance of the designed scheduling method is tested. The final results can prove that when the proposed method is used to schedule the network resources, the balanced load difference of the resources is low and has a more desirable balanced scheduling effect.

articleTitle: Research on the Technology of Rapid Import and Feature Extraction of STL Digital Model for Complex Components
publicationTitle: 2023 9th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: Aiming at the redundancy of STL digital analog data and the complexity of feature extraction in complex cabins, this paper studies the rapid import technology of binary file and text file STL digital analog formats, and implements the rapid import of digital analog through this system. According to the triangular mesh model of STL mathematical model, features such as vertex and normal vector, area, and center point of the triangular surface of the work piece are extracted. Based on the geometric and topological characteristics of triangular patches, the subdivision is performed using a dual deviation angle surface subdivision algorithm and a projection surface subdivision algorithm, respectively. According to the idea of hierarchical trajectory planning algorithm, trajectory planning is performed for each simple sub piece, and finally the trajectory is connected to form a complete spray trajectory.

articleTitle: Research on Data Fusion and Sharing Based on Power Big Data
publicationTitle: 2023 9th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: This paper addresses the issues of data silos and information asymmetry in the power industry, proposing a data fusion and sharing platform based on power big data. The paper also presents practical operations and application case demonstrations. The platform optimizes and integrates various stages of power big data collection, storage, processing, and sharing, providing new ideas and methods for the digital transformation and intelligent upgrading of the power industry. Additionally, this paper proposes corresponding solutions to address security and privacy concerns that may arise during the data fusion and sharing process. Through the establishment of an experimental environment and practical operations, the feasibility and effectiveness of the platform are verified, offering new insights and approaches for the digital transformation and intelligent upgrading of the power industry.

articleTitle: Research and Application of Inventory System Based on Visual Recognition
publicationTitle: 2023 9th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: This paper designs a visual recognition based inventory system, which involves: determining the types of inventory targets; Install at least visual recognition cameras and 5G customer terminal equipment in the warehouse; Building a counting model for cigarette trays in storage locations based on the PatMax algorithm and PatQuicks algorithm; Train the counting model of cigarette trays in storage locations; Use a visual recognition camera to take photos of cigarette trays, and use a trained cigarette tray counting model to identify the quantity and brand of cigarettes in the storage tray or non whole tray; Upload the recognition results to the server through the 5G customer terminal device; Analyze and compare the recognition results through the server to obtain statistical results. The research content of this paper can achieve intelligent and unmanned inventory management in flat inventory inventory, and improve the accuracy of inventory management.

articleTitle: Research and Application of a New Mobile IP Tunneling Technology
publicationTitle: 2023 9th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: In order to keep the connectivity of mobile nodes, the mobile IP technology comes into being. This paper mainly introduces the general situation of Mobile IP and its key technologies and working principles. According to the current situation, this paper analyzes the problem of "Triangular routing" in Mobile IP technology and its basic solution.

articleTitle: Optimal Decision-making Model Based on Nearest Neighbor Resampling Information System
publicationTitle: 2023 9th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: In recent years, ecological conservation has been increasingly integrated with information collection techniques, based on In order to achieve a sustainable development strategy, this paper develops a mathematical model that integrates a map of the Maasai Mara habitat and a four-dimensional raster map using the example of the Maasai Mara Ecological Reserve in Africa, the integrated map was resampled twice by using the nearest-neighbor resampling method to extract usable data, and the Maasai Mara Reserve into three regions, developed nine indicators to measure the relationship between the policies implemented at different times and the conflicting interests of ecosystems and local populations, and finally determined the optimal management strategy using a nonlinear programming algorithm. This paper provides a relevant reference for political formulators to make specific strategic decisions in ecological conservation and has a certain value of generalization.

articleTitle: Research on the Construction of "Internet +Culture" Communication Path of Jinan Yellow River Cultural Tourism under the Background of Big Data
publicationTitle: 2023 9th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: With the wide application of big data, mobile Internet and other technologies, the dissemination of Yellow River culture is facing new opportunities and challenges. The research conclusions of the era of big data and the transmission of the Yellow River culture have clarified the important status of the Yellow River culture, led to the discussion of the effective path of the Yellow River culture transmission in the era of big data, and analyzed and interpreted the current transmission path of the Yellow River culture in detail from three aspects: mobile Internet, big data and artificial intelligence algorithm technology.

articleTitle: Building Sports Decision Support System based on Big Data Algorithms and Analysis Techniques
publicationTitle: 2023 9th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: Decision-making, as a discipline, is a comprehensive science spanning across cognitive science, social science, and natural science. It involves various aspects of people's daily life, economy, politics, and society. The goal of decision support systems is to provide assistance in completing tasks. Currently, in schools, sports activities mainly focus on amateur exercise and classroom learning, and are in a disordered state. Therefore, based on big data algorithms and analysis techniques, this paper fully mines the internal correlations and information of sports teaching information, designs a sports decision support system, constructs the overall structural model of the sports decision support system, analyzes the technical indicators and modular architecture of the system, develops software in the embedded Linux kernel structure, and utilizes VIX bus technology to collect sports data. The sports decision support system's benefits are vast, as it provides a structured approach to sports teaching that can assist coaches and athletes in making informed decisions. The system can be used to analyze athletes' performance, monitor their progress, and identify areas that need improvement. Additionally, coaches can use the system to develop training plans and strategies that are tailored to the athletes' needs. Through simulation experiments, it was found that this system has high accuracy and reliability.

articleTitle: The Application of Virtual Reality Technology Based on Computer Vision in the Field of Youth Sports Movement Correction
publicationTitle: 2023 9th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: Virtual reality technology can simulate various activities and scenarios in physical education activities by combining it with computer hardware and software technology. The input of acquired participant gesture information interacting with the virtual scenes can provide effective and objective data analysis, thus aiding physical education activities. In sports, especially professional sports, there are many movements that athletes need to practice repeatedly, and if they can evaluate their performance and movements in a visual, systematic and comprehensive way during the sport, they can get better training results. But on a practical level, it is difficult to do this in sports, as neither the coaches nor the cameras can control the athletes' movements in a full-view situation. The emergence of VR technology can fully display the athletes' own movement data in a three-dimensional form in the computer, providing an objective and correct basis for correcting the athletes' movements. Therefore, this paper analyzes the direction of the application of computer vision virtual reality technology in the field of sports movement correction. Specific ways of implementation are described, including virtual reality, 3D reconstruction, and image pre-processing, which can correct youth sports movements and thus contribute to the improvement of physical education. By combining with computer hardware and software technology, virtual reality technology can simulate various activities and scenes in physical education activities, and inputting the acquired participant posture information to interact with virtual scenes can provide effective and objective data analysis, thus assisting physical education activities. This paper analyzes the direction of the application of computer vision virtual reality technology in the field of sports movement correction, and describes the specific ways of implementation, including virtual reality, 3D reconstruction and image preprocessing, which can correct youth sports movements and thus promote the improvement of physical education.

articleTitle: Design of a Configurable Digital Phase Locked Loop Circuit
publicationTitle: 2023 9th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: With the increasing demand for communication technology in the application of AIoT products, digital phase-locked loops are increasingly being adopted in modern digital transmission technology due to their advantages such as wide frequency modulation range of local oscillator signals and flexible and configurable modularity. This article designs a All Digital Phase-Locked Loop frequency modulation and demodulation device. With smart PD module design, low pass filter design, and NCO design, the whole ADPLL circuit is built up. Simulation and verify is executed for its functional characteristics, and can be used in high-performance communication.

articleTitle: Implementation of Artificial Intelligence Anime Stylization System Based on PyTorch
publicationTitle: 2023 9th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: In the field of computer image vision, with the rise of artificial intelligence and deep learning, the image style migration techniques used are becoming more and more sophisticated. To address the problem that style migration based on traditional techniques has strong limitations and one procedure can only implement a single scene, this paper first discusses the model structures of ANN (artificial neural network) and MLP (multi-layer perceptron), and the loss functions, and then the design and implementation of an artificial intelligence animation stylized system based on ANN and MLP is proposed. Through the test results of the system, it can be verified that the algorithm implementation used in the system corresponds to multiple types of image styles, and the results of migration conversion can also achieve a high degree of agreement with the original image samples, finally A system for converting multiple image styles has been implemented.

articleTitle: Avoiding Optimal Mean Calculation Robust PCA Based on the Nested ℓP -Norm and ℓ2,p -Norm
publicationTitle: 2023 9th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: In recent research, researchers have developed various robust principal component analysis (PCA) methods that remove the optimal mean calculation automatically to handle high-dimensional data with outliers. However, they still exhibit sensitivity to outliers since they cannot efficiently mitigate the effect of samples that deviate significantly from the rest data. To address these problems, we propose a unique robust PCA method based on the nested ℓ<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">p</inf> -norm and ℓ<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2,p</inf> -norm. In our method, we are not required to calculate the optimal mean. Specifically, our method employs ℓ<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> -norm on the spatial dimension to retain the desirable properties of PCA such as rotational invariance while we leverage ℓ<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">p</inf> -norm as the distance metric to measure the projected difference between each pair of instances and suppress the effect of outliers. Consequently, our method enhances the robustness to outliers. We provide a theoretical analysis and an iterative optimization algorithm to obtain the optimal solution for our method. Empirical results on synthetic datasets, UCI datasets and face recognition databases validate the effectiveness of our method in processing high-dimensional data.

articleTitle: The Simulation and Analysis of the DV-Hop Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 9th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: After studying the localization algorithms for Wireless Sensor Networks, the principles of the DV-Hop algorithm were introduced, and simulations were conducted using MATLAB. The influence of beacon node ratio, communication radius, and the total number of nodes on the positioning accuracy was summarized. The results showed that the minimum positioning error could only reach around 0.3, indicating that the DV-Hop algorithm has limited accuracy. The reasons for this were also analyzed. This study lays the foundation for further research in this area.

articleTitle: Design of a Cognitive Radio Network Architecture based on Tactical Conditions
publicationTitle: 2023 9th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: Cognitive radio technology has the advantages of intelligent electromagnetic spectrum perception, interference avoidance and dynamic spectrum access, so using cognitive radio technology can improve the electromagnetic perception ability based on complex electromagnetic environment. Due to the particularity of the complex electromagnetic environment, it is necessary to establish a cognitive radio architecture suitable for tactical tasks. This paper first analyzes the characteristics of tactical communication in the complex electromagnetic environment, the application of cognitive radio technology in the tactical network, and the current situation of foreign tactical cognitive wireless network. Combined with the characteristics of high mobility of tactical communication network and complex electromagnetic confrontation, using the tactical network structure and model under the confrontation environment, the hierarchical tactical cognitive radio network structure and network management method for combat tasks are put forward, so as to form a network architecture with topological structure, hierarchical and phased management and operation. The network architecture equilibrium considers the flexibility and stability of the network, which is suitable for dynamically changing tactical networks, and provides a reference for the technical application and network design of cognitive radio in tactical communication.

articleTitle: Research on Power Supply Chain Security Risk Monitoring based on Particle Swarm Optimization
publicationTitle: 2023 9th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: Risk monitoring is the main content of supply chain security, but in the process of power management, the supply situation and supply content will affect the monitoring results and reduce the accuracy of risk monitoring. Based on this, this paper proposes a particle swarm optimization method to analyze the risk monitoring information, improve the level of supply chain security monitoring, and shorten the time for formulating risk monitoring portfolios. Then, make a comprehensive judgment on the supply chain data. Finally, the risk monitoring information is analyzed by particle randomization, and the final monitoring results are output. The results show that the particle swarm optimization method can accurately carry out risk monitoring information and improve the level of risk monitoring information, and the accuracy is greater than 95%, which is better than the manual detection method. Therefore, the particle swarm optimization method can meet the requirements of risk monitoring information and is suitable for dynamic analysis of supply chain security.

articleTitle: Research and Practice on Improving the Efficiency of Digital Chip Design Description Language
publicationTitle: 2023 9th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: Verilog HDL is currently the most widely used description language for digital integrated circuit design in the semi-conduction industry, and it has the best compatibility with backend EDA tools. Originally developed as a modeling language, Verilog HDL has limitations such as low abstraction level, low flexibility in syntax, and high redundancy in code, especially in the era of VSLI and SoC design. This paper maintains the basic syntax of Verilog HDL while incrementally improving it to form a design description method for digital chips (ASICs) design based on Verilog HDL (IVL: Improved Verilog HDL Language). The results of actual project code analysis show that IVL can reduce the input code volume of digital chip design by more than 40%, effectively improve code input efficiency, enhance code abstraction ability, and improve code maintainability.

articleTitle: Research on the Architecture Scheme of the Digital Analysis Platform of Internet Public Opinion
publicationTitle: 2023 9th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: With the rise and development of Internet technology and Internet media, the behavioral group of Internet people has gradually formed. In the era of the Internet and new media, occupying the commanding heights of public opinion and the right to speak internationally is crucial to maintaining social stability and strengthening the country’s soft power. Research has been carried out to grasp the comprehensive situation of media communication power and guide the real-time situation, which is of great significance for timely grasping of the trend of public opinion of major events, media topic selection and decision-making of the competent department's propaganda and command.

articleTitle: Method for Measuring the Spatial Position and Attitude of Hoisted Objects Based on UWB and Binocular Stereo Vision
publicationTitle: 2023 9th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: To solve the problem of accurate measurement of the position and attitude of hoisted objects, the UWB and binocular stereo vision were studied. Taking the floor-standing double jib crane for overhead transmission line tower construction as an example, the installation and layout of UWB technology were explored to measure the position of hoisted objects roughly during the hoisting stage. Simultaneously, a binocular vision measurement module was designed, and its principle, process, and accuracy were investigated to accurately measure the position and attitude of hoisted objects during the attitude adjustment stage. A measurement method based on UWB and binocular vision technology was proposed, which achieved accurate measurement of the spatial position and attitude of hoisted objects.

articleTitle: Research on the Reconstruction Method of Geomagnetic Observation Data Based on Improved BP Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2023 9th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: In response to the problem of large-scale data loss caused by power outages, instrument failures, and the removal of abnormal data during the observation of various components of geomagnetic data in Shandong Province, this paper proposes a geomagnetic observation data reconstruction method based on an improved BP neural network. By selecting a reference station within a certain range from the missing data station as input, the predicted output value is used as the reconstruction data for the missing data station, The application of this method to the interpolation processing of geomagnetic data in Shandong region has achieved good results, solving the problems of low effectiveness and poor universality of current interpolation reconstruction methods for geomagnetic observation data.

articleTitle: Universal Fruit Plants Pests and Diseases Detector based on Deep Transfer Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 9th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: Pests and Diseases of fruit plants often originate from the leaves of plants. Distinguishing the features of leaves is the main means of identifying pests and diseases. Considering that non-destructive testing and early identification are the key to the disposal of pests and diseases in ecological agriculture, an universal detector of fruit plants pests and diseases based on deep transfer learning is implemented. The detector is mainly integrated by the camera module which used to collect the leaf surface image, and it is detected by the deep transfer learning model burned into the STM32 microcontroller, and the LCD displays the results. In the case of insufficient samples in the early stage of pests and diseases, by introducing transfer learning to use pre-training datasets for model pre-training, and then finetunes the model with a small number of collected samples, and the accuracy rate of more than 98% can still be obtained. Experimental results demonstrate the superiority of the deep transfer learning model, ensuring the universality and robustness of the detector. The detector has the advantages of low cost, high accuracy, easy operation, which meets the development goals of smart agriculture.

articleTitle: Design and Simulation of Synchronization Algorithm Multi-Agent Systems by Impulsive Force
publicationTitle: 2023 9th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: This paper investigates the problem of synchronization and simulation of networked multi-agent system. A distributed control algorithm is designed for systems with fixed graph topology by impulsive force. The criteria of output, coordinates and velocities impulsive synchronization for networked multi-agent system are proposed. Numerical simulation is presented to illustrate the effectiveness of the proposed algorithm.

articleTitle: A Survey on Graph Neural Networks Method under Social Recommendation
publicationTitle: 2023 9th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: With the exponential growth of online data, the social recommendation system conducts a comprehensive analysis of user-item interaction and user-user social relationships to understand the user’s interests and generate personalized recommendations. The integration of graph neural networks and social recommendation is a current hot topic in academia. Based on the survey, we reviewed the social recommendation system constructed using graph neural networks technology. We introduce the recommendation system and graph neural network framework, analyze the challenges faced by the graph neural networks in recommendations, and discuss possible solutions. Finally, we summarize and classify the coping methods in social recommendation based on existing research.

articleTitle: Construction of Virtual Simulation Experiment System for the Course of Automatic Control Principle
publicationTitle: 2023 9th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: Automatic Control Principle is a theoretical, systematic and applied professional basic course, and its experimental teaching is an important part of course teaching. According to the characteristics of experimental teaching content, this paper discusses the construction of virtual simulation experiment teaching system. The content system and method system of curriculum virtual simulation experiment are constructed. On the one hand, it can improve students' engineering consciousness and innovation ability, on the other hand, it also provides a reference for the construction of virtual simulation experiment teaching.

articleTitle: Component Anomaly Warning and Diagnosis based on Knowledge Graph
publicationTitle: 2023 9th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: With the continuous improvement of the complexity and intelligence level of production equipment, the production capacity of production equipment is also increasing. Equipment maintenance and fault warning have become the key to ensuring the normal operation of production equipment units and reducing enterprise operating costs. Due to the complex and closely connected electromechanical structure of production equipment units, there are chain reactions and mutual influences between production equipment unit components, which increases the difficulty of abnormal fault warning for production equipment unit components. However, the accuracy of fault warning methods for production equipment unit components is currently low, resulting in maintenance personnel often not having time to make appropriate equipment rotation maintenance plans.

articleTitle: Hybrid Neural Network for the Differential Diagnosis of Pancreatic Diseases with Descriptors Determined by Bioimpedance Spectroscopy
publicationTitle: 2023 9th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: We developed a method for forming descriptors based on the results of bioimpedance spectroscopy, which forms the basis of a hybrid classifier. The hybrid classifier contains five macro layers, the first of which is based on probabilistic neural networks, and four are based on fuzzy logical inference. The structure of the device, which allows to provide the formation of the space of informative features for the hybrid classifier of pancreatic diseases, is presented. Experimental studies of software and clinical trials of a medical decision support system built on the basis of the proposed structural and functional organization of a hybrid neural network have shown that, in terms of diagnostic sensitivity and diagnostic specificity, the proposed technical solutions achieve acceptable for medical practice quality indicators for risk classification of pancreatic diseases.

articleTitle: Simulation and Safety Analysis of 6to4 Tunnel Technology Based on eNSP
publicationTitle: 2023 9th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: This article is based on the eNSP simulation tool platform, simulating the island form of IPv6, using 6to4 tunnel technology to achieve the transmission of IPv6 on an IPv4 network, and using the wireshark tool to analyze and study packet encapsulation and decapsulation. At the same time, the safety risks faced by 6to4 tunnel technology were analyzed and solutions were proposed.

articleTitle: Computationally Efficient Pairing-Friendly Curves for a 128bit Security Level
publicationTitle: 2023 9th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: Barbulescu et al. conducted a study to estimate the security of pairings using the SexTNFS method. They found that the BLS curve is a more suitable option for achieving 128-bit security, whereas the commonly used BLS12_381 curve in zk-SNARK falls slightly short of this level. ISO/IEC standard BLS12-461 curve, which provides 131-bit security, is nearly twice as slow in computation efficiency compared to the BLS12-381 curve. In this paper, we propose a new curve parameter, BLS12-383, by considering four factors that impact the computational complexity of bilinear pairings: the hamming weight of the key parameter, tower extension field, curve equation, and the type of twist. Using optimal ate pairing , our proposed curve improves computational efficiency by 5% compared to BLS12-381, while maintaining 128-bit security strength. Furthermore, it demonstrates double the efficiency of the ISO/IEC standard BLS12-461 curve.

articleTitle: Improve Fashion Landmark Detection with Cross-Stage Connection Network
publicationTitle: 2023 9th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: Accurate detection of fashion landmarks is crucial for visual fashion analysis and a variety of applications in the fashion industry. In this paper, we propose a cross-stage connection network for fashion landmark detection, which addresses the issue of diminishing accuracy benefits as the number of stages in a network increases. Our network incorporates a gate mechanism to connect feature maps from different stages in variant forms. The experiments on dataset FLD and Deepfashion show that various connection strategies achieve different performance. Merely connecting upsampling layers between stages performs best. Even though our method does not achieve all the state-of-the-art performance, the cross-stage connection is proved to enable previous multi-stage model to achieve better performance as the stage number increases.

articleTitle: Research on Laser SLAM Algorithm in Indoor Transparent Glass Environment
publicationTitle: 2023 9th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: The primary objective of mobile robot research is to ensure the safe and reliable accomplishment of mobile tasks, specifically targeting a given point in an unfamiliar environment from an unknown starting position. This paper selects the Gmapping scheme for the present scenario. Additionally, this study thoroughly investigates both the Gmapping scheme and its improved version, focusing on achieving the accurate construction of environmental maps in indoor transparent glass environments.

articleTitle: Federated Dueling DQN based Joint Beamformng and Power Alloction in UAV Network
publicationTitle: 2023 9th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: To address the problem of communication quality degradation due to inter-link interference in unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) network, a joint beamforming and power allocation (JBPA) optimization model is developed to maximize the spectrum efficiency (SE) and energy efficiency (EE) of UAV systems under the premise of ensuring the quality of service (QoS) from the space and power domains. Then, a JBPA strategy based on federated dueling DQN (F-DDQN) learning algorithm, which is an effective technology to handle communication costs and data privacy, is designed to solve the presented optimization model. Simulation results show that the proposed F-DDQN based JBPA strategy improves the spectrum efficiency and energy efficiency of UAV network, and has the advantage of rapid convergence.

articleTitle: Comparative Analysis of Advanced ML Techniques for Urdu Speech Emotion Recognition: An Acoustic Study in Low-Resource Languages*
publicationTitle: 2023 9th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: This paper presents a comprehensive comparative analysis of machine learning techniques for emotion recognition in Urdu speech, a domain that presents unique challenges associated with low-resource languages. We employ Mel- frequency cepstral coefficients to the rich SEMOUR PLUS dataset and explore the key models including support vector machines, k-nearest neighbors, long short-term memory networks, convolutional neural networks, dense neural network, few-shot learning, and Siamese network. Each model’s performance and adaptability in Urdu speech emotion recognition are rigorously assessed. The research not only underscores the potential of machine learning in emotion recognition but also spotlights the intricacies of deploying these techniques for languages with limited resources. As a prelude to future avenues of exploration, we delve into the potential of an integrated audio-centric emotion recognition system. Our findings serve as a foundational stone in the expanding realm of Urdu speech emotion recognition and offer insights for ensuing studies in similar languages.

articleTitle: Impacts of Multi-task Adversarial Training on Machine Reading Comprehension Model
publicationTitle: 2023 9th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: This paper investigates multi-task adversarial training to enhance the generalization and robustness of machine reading comprehension (MRC) models. Moreover, experiments are carried out to quantitatively analyze the interference to the model by different adversarial sample ratio, which aims to further improve the adversarial training strategy to take maximum advantage of adversarial samples. The experimental results show that the MRC model trained by the proposed multi-task adversarial training strategy has better robustness than several recent state-of-the-art (SOTA) models when facing adversarial attacks.

articleTitle: Enhancing the Explainability of Deep Learning Based Malware Detection System
publicationTitle: 2023 9th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: With the rapid development of deep learning, deep learning-based malware detection has received increasing attention because of its advantage of not relying on domain knowledge. The research community has proposed some rudimentary methods to enhance the explainability of machine learning-based malware classifiers. However, these studies lack an analysis on the explainability of DNN. Research on the explainability of DNN is more challenging because of its complexity. In this work, we first propose a feature extraction method for code data, so that the deep learning model can capture the logical structure of the code. Then we train multiple deep learning models based on source code data, including MLP, CNN, and RNN. Finally, we construct feature attribution analysis for them based on local linear approximation and feature attribution respectively, to give the important features on which the inference decision of the deep neural network malicious code detection model relies, and realize the interpretability enhancement. The experimental results of the explainable analysis show that the explainable method in this paper can capture the important features and help users analyze malware better.

articleTitle: Research on Hotel Industry Informatization
publicationTitle: 2023 9th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: With the rapid development of China’s economy and the maturity of wireless communication technology, wireless service has been widely used in various industries and fields. At the same time, the information needs of various industries have become more and more intense. The service industries such as restaurants and hotels are the most traditional and widely involved industries in our country, although information technology, including network technology, has been widely used in all walks of life in our country, but in this most traditional, the most widespread application of the industry is very little. With the increasingly fierce market competition, information is changing the hotel industry competition model and business philosophy. Therefore, the hotel industry urgently needs to improve the humanization, the personalized service ability system and the product, enhances the competitive power, enhances the economic efficiency.

articleTitle: Foveated Non-local Means Image Denoising Using Wiener filter Center Weight
publicationTitle: 2023 9th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: Inspired by the human visual system (HVS), Alessandro Foi et al. design a foveation operator to calculate the similarity of patch. The calculation of similarity is called the foveated self-similarity (FSS). Their study shows that FSS is much superior to the traditional windowed self-similarity (WSS). Non-local means (NLM) with FSS (NLM-FSS) produces a more satisfactory denoising effect. However, as with many NLMs with WSS (NLM-WSS), center weight is not considered sufficiently. This study shows that window based Wiener filter center weight proposed by Zhang also can improve the NLM-FSS.

articleTitle: Remote Sensing Monitoring and Remote Maintenance System for Medical Equipment Based on Cloud Computing
publicationTitle: 2023 9th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: Modern hospital information construction requires comprehensive coverage of clinical care, equipment monitoring and asset management. The overall architecture design of the remote sensing monitoring and remote maintenance system for medical devices based on cloud computing includes a business database server, a historical database server, and an application server. The head nurse of the clinical department can use the cloud computing browser of the nurse workstation to send equipment maintenance requests to the equipment department. In the logical structure of the system, this paper divides the system function module into two parts: the basic management module and the core business module. The core business module includes all operations in the medical equipment maintenance management system, including equipment management, equipment plan management, equipment warranty, etc. In this paper, the humidity of equipment 3 is 50%, and the system has issued a remote alarm. The temperature of equipment 5 is 35° C, and the system has issued a remote alarm when the temperature is too high. This article helps to strengthen the daily maintenance of medical devices, improve the utilization rate of devices, and keep them in good condition.

articleTitle: On Legal Risks of Face Recognition Technology Application and Its Regulation
publicationTitle: 2023 9th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: With the rapid development of economy and the advent of digital information era, the facial recognition technology (FRT) has been widely used in various fields of society. With the continuous maturity of the technology, the market demand of FRT will be accelerated, and with it will come a series of hazards and risks. The application status of FRT technology in public life is introduced, the potential legal risks brought by the application of FRT technology are analyzed, the public's views on the risks and then' awareness of rights protection are investigated, and the suggestions on the regulation of legal risks of FRT application are put forward.

articleTitle: Sensor Optimization in Large Spaces Based on RBF Neural Networks and K-means Cluster Analysis
publicationTitle: 2023 9th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: Large-scale spatial buildings are widely prevalent across the nation; however, due to their size, accurate temperature measurement is challenging, resulting in increased energy consumption for air conditioning. Based on this, this paper takes the check-in hall of a certain airport terminal in Shanghai as the research subject. It analyzes temperature key points in the check-in hall partitions and employs a numerical simulation approach (CFD) using the Airpark software for temperature cloud mapping analysis. Furthermore, it utilizes the RBF neural network for sensor quantity prediction analysis. Finally, the k-means clustering analysis method is applied to determine the sensor placement locations. The results indicate that after optimization, the economic cost of sensors has decreased by 51.55%, and the average absolute error has also reduced.

articleTitle: Research on the Construction of Cloud Audit Platform Based on Big Data Technology
publicationTitle: 2023 9th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: The rise of digital technology drives the digital transformation of audit industry. This paper combines the big data technology, uses the IaaS, PaaS and SaaS basic technology platforms in the cloud service model, and builds the big data cloud audit platform into infrastructure platform, system service platform, system application platform, end customer service platform and other levels. By constructing the basic architecture mode of cloud audit platform based on big data technology, this paper deeply analyses from the aspects of application methods and operation mechanism, and explores the information ecosystem based on cloud audit and cloud accounting platform, aiming to help the implementation of big data audit.

articleTitle: Research on the Forward Kinematics of Stewart Platform based on Broyden Algorithm and Newton-Raphson Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 9th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: This paper presents research on the computational efficiency of forward kinematics of the Stewart platform utilizing the Broyden algorithm and the Newton-Raphson (N-R) algorithm. The kinematic analysis involves deriving the inverse Jacobian matrix of the mechanism and the corresponding mathematical expression of the forward and inverse kinematics. Computation of the iterative matrix is essential in each iteration, but such computation consumes a considerable amount of time. To improve computational efficiency, a strategy is proposed for updating the iterative matrix based on error magnitude, which produces exceptional results in high-precision calculations. Python is leveraged to implement the forward and inverse kinematics solution for four algorithms, allowing us to analyze and compare their respective computation times and efficiencies.

articleTitle: Memory-Centric Microcontroller (MCU) Architecture Design and Implementation
publicationTitle: 2023 9th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: The traditional microcontroller (MCU) architectures generally rely on the CPU as the central processing unit, which often becomes a bottleneck for overall system efficiency. This paper presents a novel approach known as the memory-centric MCU architecture, along with a data transmission method. In Mem-MCU architecture, the CPU, memory, and peripherals share a common bus ring. The CPU and peripherals act as bus master devices, accessing the SRAM through the bus ring. All bus master devices are mapped to device control block data structures in the memory SRAM. After configuring the device control blocks through software, each bus master device can operate concurrently and automatically, facilitating data transfer between the bus master devices and the memory SRAM. Design and simulation results demonstrate that this method reduces chip costs, conserves CPU resources, and improves data transfer efficiency. Additionally, it enhances convenience, abstraction, and flexibility in software development.

articleTitle: DGA-based Botnets Detection based on Vertical and Horizontal Analysis of DNS Behavior
publicationTitle: 2023 9th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: The use of Domain Generation Algorithm (DGA) for communication and host control in botnets is becoming increasingly prevalent. Therefore, the detection of DGA-based botnets is of great importance for network security. However, there are still some issues in this field of research. For example, existing research has limitations such as requiring detailed detection of each host, which would consume a significant amount of computing resources and result in low detection performance. In this paper, we propose an effective method for detecting controlled hosts in DGA botnets based on DGA usage and DNS behavior. The proposed method first utilizes the DGA recognition model to filter out suspicious controlled hosts, which reduces the number of hosts to be detected. Then, a set of features is designed to characterize the DNS behavior of suspicious controlled hosts horizontally and vertically. Those features not only describe the straight DNS behavior of a host such as the query type and the query frequency but also explore the DNS behavior similarity of hosts through knowledge graphs. Based on the proposed features, machine learning classifiers are trained to implement controlled hosts detection. The proposed method is validated with the dataset ISCX-Botnet-2014. Experimental results demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed method, and the detection accuracy of the Random Forest classifier could reach 95%.

articleTitle: Research on Production Condition Identification Method of Pumping Well Based on an Improved Pattern Recognition Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 9th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: In the process of oil and gas production, indicator diagram is an important basis for production management. Diagnosing the working condition of pumping unit based on indicator diagram can quickly grasp the working state of oil well, analyze and judge whether the production parameters of oil well are reasonable. The pattern recognition technology of indicator diagram generally includes two stages: feature extraction and classification. Classification methods mainly use a few common machine learning methods such as artificial neural network and SVM. In recent years, feature extraction methods mainly include geometric feature method, grid feature and moment invariant feature methods. Due to the limitations of these extraction methods, most of them can only extract some primary feature quantities. However, using these primary feature quantities to recognize the indicator diagram often has the technical problems of low recognition efficiency and low recognition accuracy. In this paper, an improved indicator diagram pattern recognition method based on binary gradient direction histogram feature is proposed. Compared with the previous feature extraction methods, this method has good robustness, fast calculation speed and high recognition accuracy.

articleTitle: Dangerous Behavior Image Recognition Algorithm of Smart Port Based on Deep Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2023 9th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: As an important manifestation of New Infrastructure, Smart port plays an important role in promoting the development of modern information technology and changing modern business model. However, the current Smart port staff have poor safety awareness, the port safety management is difficult to implement, the emergency response capacity is weak, and the awareness of dangerous behavior problems is not deep. This has led to frequent dangerous problems in the port, posing a serious threat to the safety of people's lives and property, and also greatly hindered the better development of the smart port. In order to better solve these problems, this paper conducts an in-depth study on the image recognition algorithm of dangerous behavior of Smart port. In this paper, a new deep learning-based image recognition method is proposed to address the problems of existing image recognition methods. Through the depth neural network, the Generative adversarial network model is improved, so that the generated images can be classified, and the image recognition algorithm is optimized. And to verify the effectiveness of DNN in the application of image discrimination algorithm for dangerous behaviors in smart ports, this paper compares it with the traditional image recognition algorithm. The research results show that when the number of dangerous behavior images of Smart port is 500, it has been experimentally verified that its recognition accuracy can reach 94.40%, and the time required for image recognition is 0.29 seconds. This shows that the algorithm in this paper has high recognition accuracy, fast recognition speed, and can effectively identify dangerous behaviors in the port, which plays an important role in ensuring the safety of life and property of Smart port staff.

articleTitle: Typical Application Scenarios and Architecture Design of Power Demand Response
publicationTitle: 2023 9th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: In the context of the "dual carbon" strategy, the "ternary contradiction" of energy, electricity, safety, reliability, clean, low-carbon, and economic efficiency has become more prominent, and the system has a huge pressure on elastic regulation. It is the focus of future research work to build a new power system aggregation technology architecture to mobilize massive, flexible, decentralized and difficult to see, measure and control flexible resources. This paper analyzes the situation of the rapid growth of power system load and the large-scale access of new energy, combs the application scenarios of demand response for new power systems, studies the characteristics of demand response aggregation technology architecture, and gives suggestions on the development of demand response resources participating in power system operation, which provides important technical support for new power systems in China.

articleTitle: A Discriminative Model of Factors Influencing Faculty Title Promotion Based on Data from a Specialized College
publicationTitle: 2023 9th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: Faculty title promotion is an important matter for each institution and highly affects the development of individual teachers and the college, so it is important to clarify the influencing factors and related weights. In this paper, based on 6 years of historical data of a specialized college, we used the algorithm of feature discrimination in SAS computer big data analysis platform to screen out 8 factors indicators that can successfully promote professors, and then used the feature discrimination procedure to derive the discrimination model. After the backgeneration verification, the correct rate of discriminating successful promotion was 89.7%, and the correct rate of discriminating failed promotion was 75.8%. The article then analyzed and judged these factors and made policy reco mmendations.

articleTitle: BANet: Camouflaged Object Detection Based on Boundary Guidance and Multiple Attention Mechanisms
publicationTitle: 2023 9th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: With a wide spectrum of real-world applications, Camouflaged object detection(COD) seeks to segment objects that flawlessly fit into their surroundings. However, the inherent similarity between foreground and background makes it difficult for existing deep-learning methods to identify camouflaged objects accurately. So, we’d like to suggest a BANet for the COD task in this work. To fully integrate spatial and semantic information, we propose an attention-based spatial-semantic interaction module (SSIM) that integrates information from SwinB-Transformer and Res2Net-50. After that, a boundary generation module (BGM) based on a reverse attention mechanism is proposed to guide network learning. Finally, multiple improved channel attention (CA) and spatial attention (SA) are combined to generate prediction from the boundary and extracted features. Using four commonly used benchmark datasets, we perform extensive experiments and evaluate our strategy against other state-of-the-art (SOTA) models. The outcomes reveal that the suggested BANet works well and makes a significant improvement.

articleTitle: Classification Supervision and Optimal Grazing Problem of Grassland Grazing Area based on Improved SOM Network Model
publicationTitle: 2023 9th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: There is an urgent need for scientific supervision and management of grassland pastures. This paper proposes to use drone photos of pastoral areas combined with the improved SOM network model to classify the pastoral areas shown in the photos, and then sample each index system of the actual small grassland in pastoral areas, and then use the SOM network model to classify the sampled samples, and the results can be used to correct the previous classification results. The modified SOM network model can be used to classify and supervise the management of large grazing areas in practice. Then, according to the law of plant growth, the plant growth model and the benefit optimization model of pastoral area were established to realize the ecological balance and benefit optimization of pastoral area.

articleTitle: SINS/GNSS/DVL/CNS Integrated Navigation Fault-Tolerant Design Based on SVMFFD
publicationTitle: 2023 9th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: To improve the fault tolerance of the integrated navigation system, a federal integrated navigation fault detection and isolation algorithm (SVMFFD) based on the One-Class Support Vector Machine (SVM) is proposed. The fault detection mechanism is incorporated into the sub-filter, which allows real-time monitoring of the operational status of each component and enables timely fault detection and isolation. One-class SVM algorithm is used in the fault detection module due to its excellent classification capabilities for scenarios with singular sample data, nonlinearity, and high dimensionality. Furthermore, an information distribution algorithm based on fault information is proposed to promptly adjust the state error covariance of each subsystem. The study delves into the isolated reconstruction mechanism, which holds great significance for system reconstruction in the event of a fault. Experimental results highlight the SVMFFD algorithm’s capability to promptly and effectively detect subsystem faults, ensuring navigation stability and accuracy. The algorithm significantly enhances the positioning accuracy of the integrated navigation system, underscoring its superiority.

articleTitle: Wideband Signal DOA Estimation Based on Coprime Arrays via Joint Sparse Optimization
publicationTitle: 2023 9th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: In this work, we develop an effective algorithm for direction of arrival (DOA) estimation of wideband signals with coprime arrays. We decompose the wideband signal into multiple narrowband signals and obtain the DOA estimate of the wideband signal by jointly estimating each narrowband signal. Firstly, the coprime array is transformed into a virtual linear array by differencing, and the signal model is obtained from the covariance matrices of the original array and the positive and negative parts of virtual arrays. This model is then improved by spatial smoothing and a sparse representation (SR) is introduced to transform the DOA estimation problem into a multi-dictionary joint sparse optimization problem. Finally, a Second-Order Cone Programming (SOCP) problem is solved to obtain the DOA estimation. Analysis and simulation results demonstrate the superiority of the proposed algorithm over other existing methods.

articleTitle: Research on Task Priority Management System of Filter Rod Automatic Stereoscopic Library
publicationTitle: 2023 9th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: In order to solve the problems of untimely storage of filter rods in the high-speed station platform of the filter rod automatic stereoscopic library (ASRS) and slow response of the space hopper group, a task management system of stacker crane is developed, which specifically involves the task priority management system based on the stacker crane with one rail and two vehicles. The system is based on the stacker crane task management system SCS, combined with the upper management system WMS and stacker crane plc control system, and sets the corresponding priority for the inbound and outbound platforms of different vehicle speeds, so as to realize the task priority management of the stacker crane. The automatic stereo library for filter rods (ASRS) is tested as the object, and the results show that the system can realize the task priority management of the storage platform of the stacker, and ensure the priority response of the high-speed machine platform.

articleTitle: Research on the Construction of Library Paper Book Recommendation Model Based on Content Mining-Taking Jianghan University Library as an Example
publicationTitle: 2023 9th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: This paper connects the title and abstract of the book for topic mining, uses TF-IDF algorithm to extract keywords after word segmentation by jieba, and realizes personalized book recommendation service combined with user portraits. Find books for people, find people for books, save users' time, and improve the utilization rate of books.

articleTitle: Base Station Traffic Prediction Using Wavelet Transform and Bi-LSTM
publicationTitle: 2023 9th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: Global mobile traffic is growing exponentially with the rapid deployment of 5G networks. Predicting traffic can better allocate the number of base station carrier frequencies, so as to alleviate the pressure on base stations due to data growth. The base station traffic data can be abstracted as time series with the characteristics of trend, periodicity, and randomness, which makes it suitable for predicting by the deep learning models, especially the Bi-LSTM. But the Bi-LSTM needs to rely on a large number of training sets to consume more resources, and are susceptible to outliers. Therefore, to improve the learning efficiency and prediction accuracy, this paper presents a new method that first uses decomposition and reconstruction of wavelet transform to preprocess the data set and then uses the Bi-LSTM model to predict the traffic. The experimental results show that the method has good feasibility and superiority in predicting base station traffic.

articleTitle: Research on Adaptive Grid Method for Point Clouds Reduction
publicationTitle: 2023 9th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: In point clouds reduction, the uniform grid method can achieve rapid reduction of point clouds data, but is not sensitive to changes in object shape and curvature. Different adaptive grid sizes are proposed based on object morphology and point clouds curvature, and redundant point clouds data is deleted by median filtering.
