It not only inherits the fast and effective advantages of the uniform grid method, but also preserves object detail information. Compared to the uniform grid method, the detailed features are enhanced and the reduction efficiency is improved by 12.8%.

articleTitle: Design of Three Components for the Mobile Application Supporting Software
publicationTitle: 2023 9th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: The technology of mobile application supporting software design has been an increasingly field in the past decade. It is benefic to establish a generalized methodology to better direct the software engineering practice. After a brief description of architecture of the mobile application supporting software, this paper focuses on the design of three core components: integration network, development support environment, geographic information support. In each of the components several innovative techniques are introduced to commit the requirement specifications. The methodology of this paper can make solid contribute to the community.

articleTitle: Design of Network Security Integrated Management Platform for Scientific Research Institutions
publicationTitle: 2023 9th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: With the continuous development of information technology, the data-intensive research paradigm has supported scientific research to enter a new track. Against the backdrop of increasingly severe cybersecurity threats, cybersecurity issues have become one of the key areas of concern for research institutions. This article analyzes the main cybersecurity and data security issues faced by research institutions, proposes the construction of a network security integrated management platform, and discusses in detail the design ideas and construction content from several aspects such as functional framework design, key technology breakthroughs, and core system capability output. The purpose is to better provide cybersecurity services to researchers and institutions and provide a cybersecurity environment guarantee for scientific research innovation.

articleTitle: Deep Learning Based Ground Penetrating Radar Nondestructive Testing Technology in Highway Maintenance Application
publicationTitle: 2023 9th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: Highways are prone to developing cracks, potholes, sinkholes, and other sur-face and structural layer hidden diseases due to the combined effects of traffic loads, weather conditions, and environmental influences during their ser-vice life. GPR is a widely employed NDT technique for detecting such concealed defects in pavement structures. However, in practical detection applications, GPR mapping relies heavily on experience for recognition and analysis, resulting in low recognition efficiency. This study collected disease map-ping data at a GPR standardized disease test road and utilized simulation analysis software to generate ortho maps. These maps were used to construct an automatic identification dataset containing 900 maps. Three target recognition models, SSD, Faster R-CNN, and YOLO v5, were employed to analyze the dataset and compare their effectiveness. The results revealed that YOLO v5 model had the best application effect, with an average recognition accuracy of 90.45%. The YOLO v5 model's backbone was improved based on Swin-Transformer and FE Module, leading to significant improvements in recognition. The improved model achieved an average recognition accuracy of 94.21%, demonstrating its superior performance compared to the other two models.

articleTitle: Research on the Teaching Reform of Virtual Simulation Experiment of Tourism Management Major under the Background of Big Data
publicationTitle: 2023 9th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: Virtual simulation experiment teaching applies modern information technology to innovate traditional practice teaching from the aspects of teaching content, teaching method and teaching management, which effectively deals with the challenges of high cost, high risk and irreversible reality of traditional practice teaching, and fully embodies the new trend of practical teaching of tourism management major in the era of big data. Accordingly, this work constructs the tourism management virtual simulation experiment teaching platform, interactive platform and sharing platform based on big data technology, which will inevitably provide reference for the reform and innovation of tourism management major practical teaching in colleges and universities, and thus speeding up the goal of cultivating outstanding talents.

articleTitle: Intelligent Express Sorting System based on WeChat applet and PLC
publicationTitle: 2023 9th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: The development of the Internet of Things has made online shopping increasingly convenient. There are some significant characteristics of campus express delivery, such as multiple sorting requirements and a large amount of information input and query. Faced with the high-intensity and repetitive processes of information input and classification, it is necessary to make changes through intelligent and automated methods. This paper designs a campus express delivery platform based on WeChat mini-program and database to address the problems of low efficiency and error-proneness in manual sorting of campus express delivery. JSP, JS, PLC, MySQL and other related technologies are used to achieve automatic sorting and express information query for campus express delivery. The platform is highly targeted, practical, and convenient, and can replace manual sorting of parcels. It can operate continuously, quickly, and in large quantities, effectively reducing costs, improving efficiency, and service levels. By using it in conjunction with lockers, campus express delivery pick-up can be timely and adequately allocated, further avoiding conflicts between pick-up peaks and college students' class schedules.

articleTitle: Research on Workpiece Image Classification based on SVM and Improved SIFT Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 9th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: Aiming at the problem of slow running speed and low recognition accuracy of SIFT algorithm in multi-workpiece recognition, a solution of feature point recognition optimization, descriptor dimension reduction, approximate feature point elimination and SVM classification is proposed. The improved algorithm uses the gradient direction, gray mean value and gray difference value of 12 fields of 3 concentric circles centered on feature points. Compared with the original algorithm, the feature vector data of feature points is reduced by 44 %, and a 72-dimensional feature vector is constructed. By calculating the Euclidean distance between feature points, similar feature points are removed to reduce the number of feature points and feature descriptors. Through the SVM classification algorithm, the classification model is generated by training the feature descriptors of each type of image to identify the workpiece image. The experimental results show that the improved algorithm improves the recognition speed and accuracy.

articleTitle: Research on the IT-oriented Strategy of Cultivating Rural Tourism Talents
publicationTitle: 2023 9th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: In the process of IT development of rural tourism, professional talent training in tourism is also becoming more prominent. It is required to actively perform the talent training work of IT-oriented rural tourism professionals. This paper reviews the new requirements of rural tourism talents under informationization and the problems in training rural tourism talents. Then, it proposes the key points of training rural tourism talents oriented to IT development. It should change the concept of talent training, and increase the proportion of IT-oriented courses. Besides, it should launch various forms of teaching practice activities and build a new model of university-enterprise cooperation.

articleTitle: Application of Layered Technology in Computer Software Design
publicationTitle: 2023 9th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: Under the background of the current era, the development of computer software design work has become the main direction of industry development, and the application of layered technology is an important content in the development of software design work. In the actual application process, there is a close relationship between layering technology and computer software design. Only by combining them effectively can we lay a solid foundation for improving the quality of software design. Based on this, on the basis of explaining the principles of computer software design, this article discusses the application strategy of layering technology in computer software design from two aspects of system and function, aiming to provide some reference for relevant staff. Experimental results show that the design efficiency of computer software design can reach the highest 89.8% by using layered technology.

articleTitle: High Maneuverability Rescue Hovercraft Design
publicationTitle: 2023 9th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: High mobility rescue hovercraft is a high-speed ship that uses pressure air to form an air cushion between the bottom of the hull and the water surface (or the ground), and lifts the hull off the water surface (or the ground) through the skirt around the hull. It has the performance of hovering in the air, advancing and retreating, turning 360°, etc., and has the advantages of strong environmental adaptability, fast speed, large load capacity, and flexibility. It can quickly and safely perform search and rescue tasks under various water conditions, and the emergency rescue hovercraft products have passed the test of the National Fire Equipment Quality Supervision and Inspection Center.The high-mobility rescue hovercraft is a gasoline engine as the power, single-engine, single-propeller, double-cushion lift fan, etc. Two pairs of cushion lift fans and a duct air propeller serve as the ship’s pad lifting and propulsion system. The hull is made of fiberglass, and the lower part of the hull is a flexible apron. This hovercraft can make up for many defects and deficiencies in emergency rescue of existing assault boats and rubber boats, and is suitable for personnel rescue and equipment transportation in multi-environment areas such as water surface, swamp, ice, snow, tidal flat, grassland, desert, etc., which can effectively enhance the ability of fire rescue teams to resist floods and rescue and deal with disasters such as water ice, promote the transformation and upgrading of fire rescue teams, and ensure the safety of people’s lives and property to the greatest extent.

articleTitle: Application of the Navigational Aid Telemetry and Remote Control System in Navigational Aid Management
publicationTitle: 2023 9th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: With the continuous development of modern information technology, especially the improvement of the level of navigational aid informatization, the importance of constructing a navigational aid telemetry and remote control system has gradually emerged. By applying the navigational aid telemetry and remote control system to navigational aid management, the working status of navigational aids can be monitored in real-time, promptly restoring and maintaining abnormal navigational aids, reducing the costs of navigational aid maintenance and management, and thus promoting the level of navigational aid management. Based on an introduction to the main functions, working principles, and structural components of the navigational aid telemetry and remote control system, this paper elaborates on its application in navigational aid maintenance management. It highlights features of the system such as advanced communication methods, wide coverage, high positioning accuracy, and good extensibility. Through examples, results show that the navigational aid telemetry and remote control system can promote the external public service capacity, improve the efficiency and quality of navigational aid maintenance and monitoring management, and achieve satisfactory results.

articleTitle: Esearch on Crowd Abnormal Behavior Detection Based on YOLOV4 Improved Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 9th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: In order to find dangerous targets in the crowd in time and prevent dangerous events from happening, this paper proposes a crowd abnormal behavior detection method based on YOLOV4 improved algorithm. By deepening the depth of the backbone feature network, the network parameters are updated with the exponential moving average; then the Mosica is replaced with Mixup data enhancement function; finally improve YOLOV4's extraction feature pyramid (PAN) structure to realize the recognition. The average detection accuracy (MAP) result obtained by the original YOLOV4 algorithm training model is 76.43%, and MAP value obtained by the improved YOLOV4 model is 81.41%. Compared with the original algorithm, the detection accuracy rates of the three detection categories fire, smoke, and knife are increased by 4.64%, 7.61%, and 2.68%, respectively. The experimental results show that the crowd abnormal behavior detection system based on YOLOV4 improved algorithm accuracy.

articleTitle: Classification and Application of 3D models in GIS
publicationTitle: 2023 9th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: 3D models can display the characteristics of objects more accurately, intuitively and comprehensively, which can help decision-makers and planners understand geospatial data better. Thus, 3D models have become a research hotspot and mainstream of GIS in recent years. We analyzed the academic and applied research carried out on 3D models in GIS, sorted out several common types of 3D models in GIS and their advantages and disadvantages, and summarized the current common model application scenarios.

articleTitle: A Novel Tracking Controller Design for USV using Adaptive PID
publicationTitle: 2023 9th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: The motion control of Unmanned Surface Vessels (USVs) constitutes a complex system with time-varying, nonlinear, and multiple disturbances. Traditional PID controllers require frequent parameter adjustments for varying scenarios, which is challenging for real application. This paper proposes a novel adaptive PID (APID) controller for USVs. It can adjust the PID control parameters without manual tuning. The stability of the APID can be ensured by using the second-order dummy variable which is composed of intermediate variables and their derivatives defined by the designer. The output error of the system tends to zero, which ensures the system stability. Simulation experiments demonstrate that the novel APID controller can effectively address the deficits of traditional PID controllers and offers a promising solution for the tracking control of USVs in complex environments and mission scenarios.

articleTitle: Measurement-Device-Independent Deterministic Quantum Key Distribution
publicationTitle: 2023 9th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: Improve the secure key rate and the limited communication distance is the main goal in the field of quantum key distribution. Measurement-device-independent quantum key distribution, not only removes all detector side channel attacks, but also doubles the secure transmission distance. However, most of measurement-device -independent quantum key distribution protocols are non-deterministic. In this paper, we propose a measurement-device-independent deterministic quantum key distribution protocol that doubles the secure distance and amends the non-deterministic factor of current measurement-device -independent quantum key distribution. And with imperfect devices model assumption, we derived the formula of the performances for it and find that the limited distance can be extended over 200km with relatively high secure key rate by employing parameters of current technologies.

articleTitle: Application of Large-scale Point Cloud using Distance-based Monitoring for Live-line Work on 220kV Transmission Lines
publicationTitle: 2023 9th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: As increased social activities can lead to higher demand for electricity and greater stress on the transmission system, live-line working on 220kV transmission lines turns out to be particularly important during periods of economic growth. This paper proposes a new approach for supporting distance-based live-line monitoring using large-scale point cloud. We show how to carry out real-time distance evaluation using the Chinese BeiDou-3 system (BDS-3) and the three-dimensional (3D) point cloud data of the 220kV transmission lines. We suppose each live-line worker has been equipped with a suite of location-receiving antenna that is connected to Beidou differential devices to provide centimeter-level personal positioning information. We highlight a feature-based point cloud simplification method that can significantly reduce the complexity of point-wise distance calculation. The methods are evaluated on large-scale point cloud data composed of serval hundred million of points. The experimental results reveal that for the real-time monitoring task on each transmission line, the method can reduce 90% of the point-wise distance calculation with negligible deviation.

articleTitle: DACF-Net: Dual Attention-guided Coarse and Fine Feature Enhancement Network for Thalamus Segmentation
publicationTitle: 2023 9th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: The thalamus is the higher center of the brain, and its damage and morphological changes are closely associated with numerous neurological disorders, such as normal pressure hydrocephalus and Alzheimer's disease. Therefore, accurate segmentation of the thalamic region is clinically important for the diagnosis of neurological diseases and the study of pathological mechanisms. However, the contrast between the thalamus and the surrounding tissues is low, and the segmentation accuracy is limited, so in this paper, we propose the dual-attention-guided Coarse and Fine Feature Enhanced Network DACF-Net to accurately segment the thalamus using the coarse and fine feature-enhanced segmentation strategy. The main content is to fuse the coarse and fine features extracted from the backbone network using the dual-attention module and the pyramid pooling module, respectively, to efficiently obtain the dense contextual semantic information, and at the same time to increase the richness of the feature information. The experimental results show that the coarser and finer feature-enhanced segmentation network proposed in this paper can effectively improve the connectivity between different layers of features, and the DICE coefficients achieved on the MICCAI 2012 public dataset are 0.9382, MIoU is 0.9065, and HD is 3.151.

articleTitle: Intelligent Chemical Student Management Information System Based on Data Mining Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 9th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: With the development and application of information technology, informationization of student management has become an important part of school management. In order to improve the efficiency and quality of school management, the intelligent chemistry student management information system based on data mining algorithms has gradually become a hot topic in research. In this study, data mining analysis is used to calculate the information gain or Gini index, and select the optimal features for classification to realize the system function. At the same time, evaluation indicators such as data quality, system performance, user experience, security, extensibility, and cost-effectiveness are considered. Through the analysis of students' data, information such as learning habits can be found, which provides valuable information and decision-making support for school managers. Through experimental tests, the reaction time of the system studied in this paper is between 100-200ms, and the training time and prediction time are the shortest. The conclusion shows that the intelligent chemistry student management information system based on data mining algorithms is a system with practical application value and development prospects, and will provide school managers with more efficient, accurate and personalized student management services.

articleTitle: A Digital Distribution Network Oriented Architecture of HCPS
publicationTitle: 2023 9th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: This paper proposes a digital distribution network-oriented architecture of human cyber physical system (HCPS). It aims to enhance the quality of service of distribution network by digital tools. Firstly, we give the definitions of human unit, cyber unit and physic unit. Then we design an architecture of HCPS for digital distribution network, and discuss an application case in a power supply station. Finally, we give an outlook to cyber physical social system (CPSS) research and digital twin, and discuss the future work.

articleTitle: Innovative Design of W Plate Automatic Rope Laying Equipment based on TRIZ Theory
publicationTitle: 2023 9th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: Through the analysis of the problems in the process of W-plate artificial rope application, the existing problems are found out and the technical conflicts are determined. According to the appropriate invention and innovation principle, the solution idea and specific design scheme are obtained.Thus, an automatic equipment which can effectively solve the problem of automatic rope laying of W-plate is designed, which effectively solves the problems existing in the process of manual rope laying of W plate.

articleTitle: Application of Deep Learning Algorithm in the Design of Interactive English-Chinese Translation System
publicationTitle: 2023 9th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: With the development of global economy and culture, cross-cultural exchanges are also increasing, and the status of interactive English-Chinese translation system in its application is also increasing. Traditional machine translation is often accompanied by various limitations, such as incomplete language structure and insufficient compact of context. Due to these problems, this study uses deep learning algorithms to study and aims to improve the quality of translation and user experience. Research methods include collecting user feedback and manually evaluation data, as well as analyzing user behavior data. By training and adapting a large number of parallel corpora, we designed an English-Chinese interactive translation system based on deep learning. Experimental results show that the system is significantly better than conventional systems in terms of accuracy, fluency and naturalness. Users show higher interest and satisfaction with deep learning-based systems and stay longer during use. These results demonstrate the potential of deep learning algorithms to improve the quality of translation and user experience. Future studies could further improve the model performance to achieve a faster, more accurate, more natural, and smoother translation and interaction experience.

articleTitle: Blockchain based Trustful Spectrum Sensing and Sharing against SSDF attacks
publicationTitle: 2023 9th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: The efficiency of the cognitive radio (CR) based spectrum sharing is crucial to improve the utilization of the limited radio spectrum resources. However, efficient use of the spectrum in CR relies on accurate spectrum sensing and trusted spectrum sharing when facing spectrum sensing data falsification (SSDF) from malicious secondary users. Current centralized schemes on this issue generally suffer from heavy communication overhead, long delay and single point failure; while decentralized schemes generally have problem of heavy energy consumption and computing overhead. In this paper, we propose a blockchain based spectrum sensing and trusted sharing (BSSTS) scheme against SSDF attacks, which includes an accuracy based spectrum sensing mechanism and a contribution based spectrum sharing mechanism. In the first mechanism, we form the accurate spectrum sensing problem into an optimization model, and solve the model with a genetic algorithm. Then, in the second mechanism, we propose a lightweight consensus to allocate the available channel slots to the secondary users based on their contributions in the sensing stage. The simulations are conducted to verify the performance of BSSTS. Compared with the benchmark schemes, BSSTS can increase the idle spectrum utilization by up to 20%, and decrease the times of interfering the primary user by up to 66%.

articleTitle: The Application Research on Topology Identification of Distribution Network Based on Artificial Intelligence
publicationTitle: 2023 9th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: Based on the small number of real-time measurements in distribution network, traditional state estimation methods can not be directly used to solve the problem of topology identification of distribution network. In this paper, a state estimation method based on artificial intelligence is proposed. On the one hand, the power grid balance equation and the idea of reducing the residual value of measurement are used to eliminate the wrong topology. On the other hand, it innovatively uses the historical data of topology errors and artificial neural network technology to improve the efficiency of topology error identification and avoid the problem of incorrect scheduling caused by the misreading of measurements by the scheduler, which has certain engineering application feasibility.

articleTitle: Blockchain Enables the Construction of Trusted Traceability System for Cold Chain Food
publicationTitle: 2023 9th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: With the development of information technology, blockchain technology, with its anti-tampering and traceability characteristics, is increasingly used in various industries. With regard to the acquisition of key information such as personnel and materials in the event of a food safety incident, vertical reporting is mostly done through layers of reporting from the local to the central government, which results in a long reporting time and duplication of data content, as well as opaque transmission processes, lack of trust and "broken chains" of quality data, weak willingness to share data across departments and provinces and cities and insufficient means of information interaction, resulting in a single source of data for public services, inaccurate data analysis, and inaccurate data sharing and data analysis. At the same time, there are problems such as opaque transmission process, lack of trust and "broken chain" of quality data, weak willingness to share data across departments and provinces and cities, and insufficient information interaction, which leads to a single source of public service data, inaccurate data analysis, and weak timeliness of data sharing. This paper proposes a cold chain traceability solution based on Hyperledger Fabric, adopting blockchain application means such as first station code assignment, key information uploading, code chain combination, etc., to improve the cold chain quality and safety traceability collaboration mechanism. For enterprises and supervision to realize data interoperability and data sharing, to achieve a place to assign the code of the whole network common, a place of food safety of the whole network of traceability and early warning of the collaborative mechanism; for the general public can protect the cold chain food safety, cold chain food at ease.

articleTitle: Dynamic Network Embedding with Random Points on the Hypersphere
publicationTitle: 2023 9th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: Dynamic network embedding has recently attracted significant attention due to the challenges of network evolvement. Although previous network representation methods have proposed some static graph embedding algorithms but ignore rapid node adding situation in dynamic network. In this paper, we study the problem of learning new-added node embeddings in dynamic network. We propose a new methodology to compute node embeddings with the help of the evolvement of network structure. Firstly, we initialize the original node embeddings with static methods. Then we generate a delta vector on the hypersphere to obtain the new-added node embeddings. Additionally, our method boost the progress of network embedding by using the disappearing node at the stage of negative sampling. Finally, we evaluate extensive experiments on dynamic network data sets. Compared with previous static methods, the experimental results show that our algorithm is able to achieve better time cost and obtain excellent results in various machine learning tasks including link prediction and node classification task.

articleTitle: Complex Transitions Learning Model with Graph Attentive Network for Session-based Recommendation
publicationTitle: 2023 9th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: Session-based recommendation aims to model users’ interests based on user sequences. Most models can’t fully capture user preferences. In this paper, we propose a Complex Transitions Learning model with Graph Attentive Network, which captures item transitions in neighbor sessions comprehensively. Global and local session graphs are constructed from multiple sessions. Item representations are learned by GNNs. Specially, representation of session and final item are combined to model association between items and sessions. Experimental results indicate that our method outperforms previous models.

articleTitle: Construction and Research of Power Supplier System Based on Apriori Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 9th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: System construction is the main content of power supplier selection, but in the selection process, the settlement method and supply content will have an impact on the construction system and reduce it Rationality of system construction. In this paper, an Apriori algorithm is proposed to analyze the system construction, improve the construction level of power supplier selection, and shorten the system construction time. Then, a hierarchical analysis of the supplier data is performed. Finally, the particle customer is used to analyze the system construction and output the final construction system. The research system shows that Apriori algorithm can accurately construct the system, improve the feasibility of the system, and the rationality is greater than 86 % is better than subjective choice. Therefore, Apriori’s algorithm provides support for system construction.

articleTitle: Research on the Application of Cross platform Video Communication in Public Legal Services
publicationTitle: 2023 9th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: Video communication has been widely used in various industries due to its convenience, intuition, authenticity, and intimacy. It is also widely used in the field of public legal services such as remote consultation, remote notarization, remote mediation, and remote testimony. As an important part of the national public service system, public legal services have increasingly played an important role in promoting and enhancing the implementation of the overall rule of law strategy. However, due to cognitive, institutional, and technological reasons, there are still many difficulties in the application of cross system and cross platform video communication in the field of public legal services. In order to ensure the true inclusiveness and equality of public legal services, more in-depth research is needed to connect the cross platform business flow, video flow, and data flow of various works of public legal services from the cognitive, institutional, and technical levels, forming a data chain, service chain, and evidence chain, promoting the content of public legal services to be richer, resources to be more balanced, services to be more convenient, objects to be more extensive, and fields to be more comprehensive, To continuously improve and optimize the public legal service system.

articleTitle: Enabling Borderless Office Security: A Comprehensive Zero-Trust Digital Grid Architecture for Flexible Resource Access and Data Protection
publicationTitle: 2023 9th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: The traditional trust-based security architecture is hard to ensure data security in borderless office. To address this problem, a zero-trust digital grid security architecture for borderless office is proposed. The architecture mainly includes three aspects: user management layer, access control layer, and security control layer. This provides borderless office with more flexible resource access policies and more secure protection measures.

articleTitle: Analysis on the Digital Transformation Path of Small and Medium Potato Processing Enterprises under the Background of Rural Revitalization
publicationTitle: 2023 9th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: The potato processing industry is one of the key links in the agricultural production field and is also regarded as the core force in promoting rural revitalization strategies. Especially for small and medium-sized potato processing enterprises, they constitute the main driving force for the progress of the potato industry, and digital transformation has become an indispensable path for these enterprises to achieve high-quality development. However, these small and medium-sized potato processing enterprises still face many obstacles in the process of digital transformation, such as uncertainty in the transformation route, lack of talent resources, weak technical foundation, and lack of application capabilities, as well as difficulties in financing. Given this, we have proposed a series of strategies to help these small and medium-sized potato processing enterprises overcome these challenges and achieve digital transformation. These strategies include gradually advancing the process of digital transformation, comprehensively cultivating digital talents, strengthening the technological foundation and application capabilities of digital transformation, and utilizing blockchain technology to innovate financing methods. Our goal is to provide support for the digital transformation of small and medium-sized potato processing enterprises through these measures.

Author Keywords: Small and medium-sized potato processing enterprises

articleTitle: Encryption and Anti-tampering Technology of Buddhist Digital Archives
publicationTitle: 2023 9th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: In traditional Buddhist archival management, paper archives are constrained by physical environments and human factors. The emergence of digital archives has introduced new possibilities for archival management. Using digital signature technology with computer systems as the medium, identity, user permissions, and access methods are conveyed through data information. All actions conducted in a networked environment must be recorded in electronic files. Unauthorized access and tampering issues make digital archival management more challenging, posing threats to the security and integrity of Buddhist digital archives. This paper aims to study encryption and anti-tampering technologies for Buddhist digital archives. By applying cryptography and digital signatures, we aim to enhance the data security of Buddhist digital archives. To improve encryption and anti-tampering techniques, this study starts from the technical architecture involved and adopts experimental verification and data comparison methods to qualitatively and quantitatively analyze protection methods for digital archives. Experimental results show that the RSA-1024 algorithm has the fastest rate at 64 bits, indicating its certain advantages in encryption and anti-tampering for Buddhist digital archives.

articleTitle: Research on Digital Twin System Architecture for Intelligent Manufacturing Internal Control
publicationTitle: 2023 9th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: Aiming at the internal control issue of intelligent manufacturing, this paper proposes an architecture system on the basis of digital twin. Combined with the digital twin technology model, this research offers a better solution for the internal control optimization of intelligent manufacturing with complex constraints and uncertainties. In this paper, the hierarchy of technical architecture of intelligent manufacturing internal control system based on digital twin is defined. The construction mechanism of multi-level and multi-dimensional virtual workshop is put forward, and the basic unit model of multi-dimensional fusion is described. A data architecture model of data collection, processing, storage and control driven by twin data is proposed. This research aims to provide some reference for the efficient development of internal control in the intelligent manufacturing process of manufacturing enterprises.

articleTitle: Research on Semi Supervised GAN Network Algorithm for Automatic Generation of Cable Construction Plan
publicationTitle: 2023 9th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: Cable construction has always relied on the experience of construction personnel to deploy and implement, lacking advanced construction plan automatic generation algorithms for digital information planning of the entire construction process, resulting in low efficiency. Changing the current situation of the entire industry requires comprehensive innovation and intelligent transformation of the power construction process from the software and hardware aspects of cable construction plan generation methods, advanced and innovative IoT construction devices, etc. This paper adopts the artificial intelligence countermeasure network GAN model, proposes the cluster consistency Loss function, improves the feature matching method and feature matching method, optimizes the training generator parameters, generates self-learning data, and cooperates with the construction scheme generation platform to generate a more intelligent and optimized automatic output cable construction scheme.

articleTitle: 1DCAE-PSO-SVM based Fault Diagnosis Techniques for Voltage Source Inverter
publicationTitle: 2023 9th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: Aimed at the power switch open circuit fault occurred in the inverter, the paper proposed one dimension convolutional autoencoder (1DCAE), particle swarm optimization (PSO) and support vector machine (SVM) based fault diagnosis algorithm of inverter. 1DCAE is used to obtain fault feature from phase current of inverter, PSO is used to determine penalty parameter C and kernel function parameter with SVM. The experimental results show that the techniques proposed in the paper has higher fault diagnosis accuracy.

articleTitle: Medical Image Segmentation with Explainable Diffusion Models
publicationTitle: 2023 9th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: Diffusion models have made great success in image generation and own much potential in other vision tasks like image segmentation. With respect to medical image segmentation (MIS), model interpretability is indeed as important as model accuracy. This paper introduces the fundamental situation of MIS and typical diffusion model-related frameworks for MIS. Interpretability issues are also discussed in earnest.

articleTitle: JAVA Based Data Acquisition Technology Design
publicationTitle: 2023 9th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: Data harvesting refers to the acquisition of data information from websites by means of web crawlers or public APIs of websites, etc. This method can extract unstructured data from web pages, store them as unified local data files, and store them in a structured manner. In this paper, we propose a simple data collection system. This system mainly includes the functions of data information collection, data intelligence analysis, and processing, ontology knowledge construction, etc. By establishing domain ontology, we collect data information and use the ontology to analyze and cluster the data information.

articleTitle: Research on Predicting the Frequency Variation of 5G Terminal Time Standard Based on LSTM Deep Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2023 9th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: In this paper, we introduce a method of using long short-term memory (LSTM) neural network to predict the time-frequency variation of atomic clocks which are used as time primary standards for 5G communication terminals. We designed a LSTM networks model and trained it using the relative frequency data records of 10 different atomic clocks in NIM during 291 days. Additionally, we discuss the influence of LSTM neural network parameters on its predictive ability. It can be seen from experiments that the LSTM method has well prediction accuracy and repeatability. In particular, it has an advantage in capturing partial frequency hopping.

articleTitle: Research on Information Management of Budget Hotels in Shandong Province under the Background of Big Data
publicationTitle: 2023 9th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: Nowadays, the rapid development of big data technology, in the context of such big data, information always affects people's lives, driving the development of the hotel industry to a certain extent. Since entering the 21st century, economy hotel become the hot spot of the domestic hotel industry development, budget hotel only by improving their core competitiveness, to better survival and development, so budget hotel should use the present big data background to promote its development in a better direction, information management is one of the crucial link. Taking budget hotels in Shandong Province as an example, this paper analyzes the problems existing in the information management of budget hotels in Shandong Province under the background of big data, and puts forward corresponding solutions, hoping to promote the information management level of budget hotels in Shandong Province.

articleTitle: An Analysis of the Technical Trend of Semantic Search in Natural Language Processing
publicationTitle: 2023 9th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: Semantic search is an important task in Natural language processing (NLP). It aims to improve the accuracy of search results by understanding the meaning of search queries. This paper introduces the basic concepts, development history, and application status of semantic search in different fields, and explains the current challenges of semantic search, such as polysemy and ambiguity problems, semantic understanding and semantic modeling.This paper mainly describes the main natural language processing technologies in semantic search, including deep learning-based methods, text representation, intent recognition, relationship extraction, and machine learning. Finally, this paper discusses the trends and prospects of semantic search development in the future.

articleTitle: Discussion on the Application of Digital Road Holography Business
publicationTitle: 2023 9th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: The construction of digital road holographic application system has become an important means for the construction and long-term operation of smart cities. This article first analyzes the current development status of digital roads, then analyzes the key capabilities of digital road holographic applications from three perspectives, and proposes an overall solution for digital road holographic business applications. Finally, from the long-term development of digital road holographic business applications, development suggestions are given

articleTitle: Analyzing Composition Complexity in Revised Versions through Artificial Intelligence-Based Writing Assistants
publicationTitle: 2023 9th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: Artificial intelligence-based correction systems have brought convenience to English learners’ writing practice. Grammarly is an online AI-powered essay revision software. This paper explores the changes in the writing complexity of essays after being corrected by this software compared to their original versions. Lexical complexity and syntactic complexity are important aspects of second language writing. Therefore, this study selects three lexical complexity indicators and ten syntactic complexity indicators to measure the changes in essays before and after being corrected by Grammarly. The research findings reveal that university-level English essays, after being modified by the AI-powered correction system, do not exhibit significant increase in lexical aspects, specifically in lexical density and lexical sophistication, while the indicator of lexical variation shows a noticeable decrease. On the other hand, in terms of syntactic complexity, four indicators—MLC(mean length of clause), CPC(coordinate phrase per clause), CP/T(coordinate phrases per T-unit), and CN/C(complex nominals per clause)—demonstrate a significant increase. This suggests that students can benefit from Grammarly’s assistance in essay correction training in terms of syntactic complexity, while the improvements in vocabulary complexity are not substantial.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of MOOC Platform Based on Computer Network Technology
publicationTitle: 2023 9th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: This paper describes the design and implementation of MOOC platform for network technology major of wuhan polytechnic. It mainly includes the functions of the MOOC platform and the teaching methods based on the MOOC platform. And the realization of MOOC platform functions.

articleTitle: A Fast Fatigue Detection System Based on Speech Voiceprint Information
publicationTitle: 2023 9th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: In order to ensure safe production and solve the problem of time-consuming and labor-intensive for detecting human fatigue, we have developed a fast detection software for human fatigue based on speech voiceprint information. This article first collects the language voiceprint information of the subjects, extracts the feature data of the language, and then uses machine learning algorithms to detect human fatigue. The experimental results indicate that the software could detection of human fatigue rapidly, and has high accuracy, especially for severe fatigue detection.

articleTitle: Evaluation Index System and Method of Power Dispatching Training Resources Based on Multi-level Fuzzy Comprehensive Evaluation Model
publicationTitle: 2023 9th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: In order to continuously improve the training quality of the power dispatching cloud training system, it is necessary to evaluate the training resources in the training system. Based on the multi-level fuzzy comprehensive evaluation method, the training resource evaluation system of the power dispatch cloud training system is established. Experts in the field of power systems are invited to make pairwise comparison of the importance of evaluation indexes at the same level, and establish a judgment matrix at all levels, and the weight coefficient is determined by AHP method. Through the combination of sending questionnaires to experts and trainees for subjective evaluation and objective data evaluation of training management system, the 5-level evaluation of training resources is realized, which provides a basis for the training system to recommend, improve, and delete resources.

articleTitle: Research on the Design of Edge Computing Artificial Intelligence Vision Chip Based on Hardware Simulation System
publicationTitle: 2023 9th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: The widespread application of visual deep learning algorithm based on convolutional neural network promotes the rapid development of design and research of artificial intelligence visual chip, and chip design verification is the bottleneck of the development of artificial intelligence visual chip. With the emergence of convolutional neural network technology, visual deep learning algorithm is widely used, which plays an important role in promoting the design and research of artificial intelligence visual chip. However, in the development process of artificial intelligence visualization chip, chip design problems still exist. This paper focuses on the design of edge computing artificial intelligence vision chip based on hardware simulation system.

articleTitle: Application of Deep Semantic Understanding in Civil Aviation Airport
publicationTitle: 2023 9th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: in recent year, semantic understanding is very important input method in Human-Computer Interaction (HCI), especially for some minority group who can only communicate with others by voice interaction. Nowadays, semantic understanding has been widely used in many fields. With the development of deep learning, artificial intelligence, and other computer technologies, semantic understanding has achieved breakthrough research progress, recently, a new viral bot, ‘ChatGPT’, was released by the artificial intelligence company ‘Open AI’ in November 2022. However, The ChatGPT cannot provide precise information in professional field. In this paper, we will introduce a semantic model tool which will apply in civil aviation field, provide accurate information during the airport traveling process.

articleTitle: Sorting Structure Design of Automatic Campus Express Sorting System
publicationTitle: 2023 9th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: With the rapid development of e-commerce platforms, people's habits have started to change. More and more people are engaging in online shopping, with students accounting for a significant proportion. As recipients of emerging trends, college students' total online shopping consumption has been increasing year by year. Due to the large quantity of campus deliveries, issues such as high sorting error rates and low efficiency often occur. In this paper, we propose a new type of intelligent campus express sorting system that addresses the slow sorting speed and limited area of distribution centers. This device consists of sorting and conveying mechanisms, enabling accurate identification and sorting of packages, meeting the demands for special item sorting, improving efficiency, and achieving closed-loop collaboration with downstream storage lockers. The structure exhibits high levels of automation and intelligence, providing a new approach for the comprehensive design of campus express sorting systems in the future.

articleTitle: Research on Non-contact three-dimensional Human Body Scanning Based on the Anthroscan M4 System
publicationTitle: 2023 9th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: Chinese clothing industry is developing rapidly, and three-dimensional human body scanning technology is an important component of the digital and intelligent development of clothing. Compared to traditional human body measurement, the advantage of three-dimensional human body scanning technology is very obvious. It is faster, more comprehensive, and more accurate. However, the three-dimensional human body scanning technology has fast iteration and also has some practical application problems. This article analyzes the existing three-dimensional human body scanning technology, investigates the broad application prospects in the development process of clothing intelligence who rely on the practical application of Anthroscan M4 system, from the establishment of databases, research on human body modeling, application of clothing virtual fitting, personalized customization, three-dimensional online fitting, and other aspects.

articleTitle: The Application Research of Deep Learning Technology in the Automatic Monomer of Buildings
publicationTitle: 2023 9th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: In this paper we aim at building automatic monomer by using orthophoto figure with the help of ArcGIS Pro software which provides deep learning and a series of space processing tools. And through optimization of processing methods, we finally realize construction, road network and other battlefield environment data fast automatic monomer and support the wisdom city construction and digital battlefield construction.

articleTitle: BORT-RD: An Improved Model for Software Engineering Design Feature Generation
publicationTitle: 2023 9th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: By studying the connections and dependencies between requirement features and design features in software development documentation, and incorporating the advantages of various Transformer-like models, a BORT-RD model applicable to generating design features is proposed in this text. This model is based on the syntactic decomposition of requirement documents and design documents to train feature phrases. The model has been improved in terms of input embedding, attention calculation and fine-turning, targeting the characteristics of software engineering documents. Through experiments, the model’s precision, accuracy and recall have been increased to 81.18%, 94.4%, and 83.1%, respectively, showing significant improvements compared to traditional classical Transformer models.

articleTitle: Energy Efficient Offloading in Mobile Edge Computing under Limited Resources
publicationTitle: 2023 9th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: Energy consumption is one of the most important issues which wireless mobile devices are facing. This paper studies the minimum energy consumption problem under limited computing and channel resources by using dynamic voltage and frequency regulation (DVFS) techniques for mobile edge computing systems under time division multiple access(TDMA), and proposes a minimum energy consumption offloading strategy(MECOS) based on the internal penalty function method. The simulation results show that, depending on the number of users, the algorithm proposed in this paper can reduce energy consumption by 9.83% to 24.04% compared with the benchmark offloading strategy, and has good convergence, scalability and robustness.

articleTitle: Intrusion Detection System of Web Application Based on SVM and Word2Vec
publicationTitle: 2023 9th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: This paper mainly studies the web log generated by the data center, with considering all data for both get and post requests, constructs the feature vector with word2vec, and builds the model with support vector machine. Based on MapReduce parallel computing model, an anomaly intrusion detection algorithm is proposed, and a security analysis platform based on Web log is constructed. The system operation results show that the platform can effectively find abnormal intrusion in the campus network, with high retrieval efficiency, and can effectively improve the operation and maintenance efficiency and abnormal troubleshooting speed.

articleTitle: A Digital Twin Watershed Three-dimensional Solid Topography Data Backplane Creation Method
publicationTitle: 2023 9th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: In response to the defects of non-editability and poor coordination of the watershed GIS based on digital elevation model construction, a method for creating a digital twin watershed three-dimensional solid terrain data backplane is proposed. The method involves preprocessing DEM data and utilizing visual programming to triangulate the terrain data points, thereby forming a three-dimensional solid terrain along the boundaries. It enables Boolean operations between the solid entities, ultimately creating a parameterizable watershed terrain data backplane. By selecting the "Model Yellow River" measured cross-section to simulate the sedimentation and erosion of the river channel under the flood peak flow rate, it is demonstrated that compared with the traditional cross-section analysis method, the three-dimensional river channel solid model can more intuitively display the distribution of sedimentation and erosion in the river channel, as well as the migration of the riverbed. Through the Boolean operations between the topography solids, the amount of sedimentation and erosion in the river channel can be quickly calculated to obtain real-time changes in the river channel. This method of terrain creation serves as a reference for the construction of a digital twin watershed terrain data backplane.

articleTitle: The Use of Data Mining in Long Tail Service of Library
publicationTitle: 2023 9th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: The research applies data mining techniques to library long-tail services, aiming to enhance the efficiency and effectiveness of library services. A system is established for this purpose, which utilizes a twice-clustering-based text outlier algorithm. This algorithm is designed to identify outliers in the data, which are then analyzed for their potential value in providing new directions for library services. The system is verified using the Wanfang database, a comprehensive Chinese academic database. The verification process involves applying the algorithm to the data and assessing the results. The algorithm successfully identifies a valuable outlier cluster, which consists of three theses. These theses have a high degree of similarity amongst themselves but a low degree of similarity with other theses in the database. This research uncovers a unique outlier cluster, offering a novel direction for library services. These theses represent an underexplored research area, embodying the 'long tail' concept in library services. The study suggests that data mining can identify new service areas, highlighting its potential in enhancing library service provision and development.

articleTitle: CNN-based Image Color Consistency for Multi-source Satellite Images: A Case Study in China’s Water Diversion Project Application
publicationTitle: 2023 9th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: Color consistency processing is important for optical satellite image mosaicking to obtain necessary geographic information, then to serve land and water resource monitoring and many other public fields. In recent years, convolutional neural networks (CNN) have been successfully used in image processing applications such as image classification, change detection, and fusion. However, there are a few studies on image color consistency, especially based on Chinese high-resolution satellite images. In this study, we proposed a new CNN-based image color consistency method that used high-resolution Google images as a reference. Combined with a CNN-based method of image fusion, we produced large-area color-consistent mosaics with high resolution based on multi-source satellite images. The loss functions and network parameters were optimized based on our dataset. We successfully applied the proposed method in one of China's mega water diversion projects ‘Yangtze-Huai River Diversion Project’ and found that it had better performance when compared with the existing methods. The proposed method does not only provide a basic tool in image mosaicking for remote sensing applications but also acts as a precedent for subsequent automated image change detection and object recognition based on deep learning.

articleTitle: Predicting the Success of Global Terrorist Attacks Based on Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 9th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: Terrorist attacks can be analysed and predicted with detailed historical data for better prevention and early warning. In this paper, we use the Global Terrorism Database (GTD) to quantitatively study the characteristics of terrorist attacks from 1970 to 2019, and construct a framework based on four machine learning classification algorithms, namely, decision trees, random forests, logistic regression, and XGBoost, to predict whether a terrorist attack can be successful. A skillful method is used to deal with the unbalanced data. Each classifier undergoes optimizing, training, and parameter search to attain optimality. The proposed framework is then evaluated to assess its performance and stability. The experimental results show that the four algorithms achieved good performance. Random Forest and XGBoost achieve the best prediction performance of high accuracy (99%) in predicting the success of terrorist attacks.

articleTitle: A Deep Learning Method for Classification of Interictal and Preictal EEG Signals in Epileptic Seizure Prediction
publicationTitle: 2023 9th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: Epilepsy is one of the most common nervous system diseases in the world, which will cause serious consequences to the patient's nerves, cognition and psychology, and affect the patient's physical and mental health and quality of life. Early detection of seizures can help prevent seizures and reduce harm through medical intervention. In this study, a deep learning (DL) framework was proposed that employs two branches to extract time-domain and frequency-domain features of EEG signals, which are then fused together to improve feature extraction and classification abilities. The proposed model demonstrates satisfactory performance in epileptic seizure prediction (ESP). To ascertain the effectiveness of the model, four experiments were conducted. Initially, five different segmentation lengths were tested in order to determine the optimal one. Subsequently, ablation experiments were executed to assess the effectiveness of the model’s components. Furthermore, the model was tested on specific patient data, resulting in an average accuracy of 0.9636 and an Fl-score of 0.9638 on the CHB-MIT dataset, outperforming other advanced models. Finally, when compared to other advanced models, the proposed framework yielded the highest accuracy in both the CHB-MIT dataset and the newborns with epilepsy annotation EEG recording dataset (DNERSA), with accuracies of 0.9943 and 0.9745, respectively. The proposed model exhibits promising potential in the field of ESP.

articleTitle: Research on Dynamic Scheduling Algorithms for Multiple AGVs under Complex Path Conditions
publicationTitle: 2023 9th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: Intelligent warehousing logistics systems employ Automated Guided Vehicles (AGVs) to fulfill the requirements of intelligent logistics transportation services. Single AGV control technology is mature, capable of handling large-scale complex path applications including intersecting paths. However, there are technical challenges in the cooperative control of multiple AGVs within dynamic and complex computational spaces. These challenges necessitate the utilization of various computational methods for path planning, to meet obstacle avoidance requirements, prevent spatial deadlock, and prevent obstructions from blocking the progress of AGVs. Centered on AGV motion control and taking path planning as the foundation, this paper primarily examines the concentrated conflicts that arise in the dynamic operation zones of multiple AGVs. Given the complexity of the traffic conditions in the algorithms employed, the DQN algorithm and neural network fitting have been incorporated to enhance the Q-value, thereby reinforcing the path planning and scheduling efficiency in intricate scenarios. For the prevalent conflicts in multi-AGV dynamic scheduling, a cooperative control approach for avoidance is proposed. This takes into account the AGV’s current coordinates, as well as the restrictions at intersections, to determine whether to wait or avoid. Rules are established so that different path conflicts can pass in an orderly fashion at intersections, avoiding congestion and collisions.

articleTitle: The Construction of Campus Informal Learning Space Driven by Computer Science
publicationTitle: 2023 9th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: The advancement of computer science has led to significant transformations in the educational approach adopted by colleges and universities. This shift has emphasized independent learning behaviors, particularly informal learning. Consequently, there is a growing need to incorporate the planning and design of informal learning spaces into campus development strategies. This paper presents an analysis of the characteristics of informal learning behaviors observed on campus, as well as an exploration of the underlying demands associated with such activities. Based on these findings, the article proposes the strategic placement of informal learning spaces within campus planning. This proposition is examined from three distinct perspectives: the functional configuration, spatial structure, and place-making represent the macro-meso-micro levels. The paper takes the campus planning design of Guangdong Hotel Management College as an example to explore the strategies employed and the effectiveness achieved in facilitating informal learning. Furthermore, we focus on three key aspects: the multi-level informal learning function system, the layout of shared informal learning spaces, and the creation of personalized informal learning environments.

articleTitle: Formation Control of Multi-UAV Systems with Time and Angle Constraints
publicationTitle: 2023 9th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: This study addresses the formation control problem of multiple fixed-wing unmanned aerial vehicles (UAV) in three dimensions, taking into account assembly time and angle constraints. A novel control strategy is proposed, which divides the system into two modules. The first module, known as the assembly stage, assembles the UAV swarm and creates a fundamental formation from arbitrary initial states. Each UAV is required to reach the designated site while considering the terminal constraints regarding both time and angles. Novel sliding manifolds have been developed, and corresponding control laws are proposed to meet the constraints in the assembly stage. The Lyapunov stability theory is employed to prove that the proposed control laws guarantee a fixed-time stable system. The second module, referred to as the formation-keeping stage, is responsible for precisely maintaining the UAV swarm’s geometric pattern. The study proposes a sliding mode control (SMC) law that uses the traditional proportional navigation guidance (PNG) for followers to trace the relative trajectories of a predetermined central leader in a leader-follower structure. Finally, numerical simulation results are presented to demonstrate the successful implementation of the proposed approach. Compared to the two other methods, our proposed approach not only satisfies the constraints but also exhibits a higher level of distance accuracy. In precise terms, our method achieves a reduction in the average distance error of 73% and 87%, respectively, when compared to the previous two methods.

articleTitle: Software Vulnerability Detection Method Based on the Lexical and Syntax Analysis
publicationTitle: 2023 9th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: The paper presented and implemented a C-Scanner source code vulnerability detection tool, which can solve the buffer overflow problem. The main idea was to rewrite the source code of a C or C++, so that the resulting code contained the safe version of the old vulnerable functions, which may contain a buffer overflow security problem. If rewriting was not possible, due to some reasons, a warning was issued along with a hint to solve the problem if it was possible. C-Scanner in this paper took the C or C++ source code as input, and then it did a parsing process. Every time it encountered a vulnerable function call, it classified this function call. If this function call was belonging to a category of its interest, then it would rewrite this vulnerable function by a safe version, which prevented the buffer overflow vulnerability.

articleTitle: An Innovative Approach to Wind Energy Production Efficiency Using Intelligent Technology
publicationTitle: 2023 9th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: With the increasing demand for renewable energy, an intelligent wind energy calculator has been developed in this study. The calculator integrates wind energy sources provides accurate predictions of wind energy generation based on multiple input variables. The prediction accuracy is achieved through the implementation of various algorithms, including the neural network algorithm. Furthermore, the calculator is designed to be user-friendly and accessible via both desktop and mobile devices. Piloted in a rural community where renewable energy is becoming increasingly prevalent, the intelligent calculator offers significant benefits in optimizing energy usage while reducing costs. Overall, this study presents a promising approach that may help promote the use of renewable energy, leading to the creation of more sustainable and eco-friendly communities.

articleTitle: Research on Quality Traceability of Outsourced Filter Rod Process
publicationTitle: 2023 9th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: The content of this paper is to study the business processes of manually covering purchased filter rods, entering the filter rod elevated warehouse, entering and exiting the flat warehouse, manually loading the rod at the emission end, and manually loading the rod on the cigarette machine, in order to achieve accurate traceability of purchased filter rods. Exploring the integration of handheld, WMS, WCS, electronic control, data acquisition, MES and other systems by relying on the production information encoding of 30 manufacturers of purchased filter rods to associate RFID. The entire process of reading and writing codes is used to read, associate, and verity the relevant information of purchased filter rods, achieving full process tracking, error prevention, and traceability of purchased filter rods. The research purpose of this paper is to effectively improve the quality management level of outsourced filter rods in the workshop in real time, reduce consumption and costs, and enhance the level of lean management in the workshop. It can provide reference and reference for the industry to promote precise traceability of filter rods.
